svg.text: The adapter exists, but there is no active link. With Wi-Fi this

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: means not connected to any network; with Ethernet it usually means

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: the cable is unplugged, the port is dead, or the adapter is

svg.text: - Wi-Fi is switched off or not connected to a network

svg.text: - The adapter is disabled in Windows

svg.text: 1. Check whether you are on Wi-Fi or Ethernet, and make sure that

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: 2. For Wi-Fi: make sure Wi-Fi is enabled (not airplane mode) and

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: 3. For Ethernet: push the cable in firmly at both ends, or try

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: 4. If the adapter shows as disabled, GeeNet can try to enable it

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: GeeNet can usually fix this automatically (safe, reversible).

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: No active network adapter was detected. Without an active adapter (Wi-Fi

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: or Ethernet switched on, enabled and connected) nothing further along

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: the chain can work, so GeeNet stopped here instead of reporting a pile

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: of predictable failures. Fixing the adapter connection is the logical

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
